inventory.moreHint: Unit · sell by case · expiry · note

stock.noPack: This product has no case/pack set up — set it on the product page or receive by unit

stock.historyHint: Tap a product to see where it was bought, the price, date and lot

pos.emptyCart: Tap a product to add it

errors.product_not_found: A product was removed — refresh the page

settings.currencyFixed: Currency cannot be changed after the store is created
settings.taxHint: Enter 0 if you are not VAT-registered

scan.title: Scan barcode
scan.hint: Point the barcode inside the frame
scan.noCamera: Cannot open the camera — allow camera access in your browser settings (requires https)
scan.stalled: Can't read it yet — tap the barcode to focus, move back a little, turn on the light, or tap ⌨ to type the digits (you can scan another item)
scan.torchUnsupported: This device/browser won't let the website turn on the flash — try updating, use Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone/iPad), or use the phone's flashlight shortcut

devices.btHint: Turn on the printer and Bluetooth, then pick it in the browser dialog
devices.autoPrint: Print receipt automatically after each sale
devices.unsupported: This browser can't connect to printers directly (e.g. iPhone) — use Print receipt, which prints through the browser
devices.scannerUsb: USB: plug it into the computer or phone (OTG cable)
devices.scannerBt: Bluetooth: pair it in the device's Bluetooth settings first (keyboard / HID mode)
devices.scannerTest: Then scan any barcode once — status changes to Connected
devices.scannerLang: Works even when the keyboard is set to another language, and no need to click a field first
devices.scannerReset: Status resets to “Not detected” whenever you close or leave the page — scan once to reconnect
devices.scannerTapHere: If nothing shows (e.g. iPad), tap this field first, then scan again

photo.title: Product photo
photo.hint: Taken with the in-app camera — crop/rotate/flip after shooting; saved as 600×600 automatically
photo.flashNo: This lens has no flash — try another lens
photo.cropHint: Drag to move · pinch or zoom slider to crop

install.title: Install EASY-POS on this device
install.subtitle: Opens fast, full screen, with an icon on your home screen — no app store needed
install.installed: Installed ✓ Open it from your home screen icon

ios: Open this site in Safari (or Chrome on iOS 16.4+)
Tap the Share button (square with an up arrow)
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”
android: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
desktop: Click the install icon (monitor with arrow) at the right of the address bar
Or click ⋮ → “Install EASY-POS” / “Apps → Install this site as an app”

import.title: Import products from Excel
import.intro: Choose an .xlsx or .csv file — columns are matched automatically. Check the preview before importing
import.formats: Supports .xlsx (Excel) and .csv — the first row must be headers
import.readError: Can't read the file — make sure it is .xlsx or .csv with a header row
import.importError: Import partly failed — please try again (already imported rows won't duplicate)
import.mappingHint: Picked from the header names — change if wrong
import.updateStock: Also update stock of existing products
import.updateStockHint: Checked = set stock from the file (logged as an adjustment) · Unchecked = only name/price/category; new products still use the file's quantity
import.rules: Barcode matches an existing product = update · no match / no barcode = new · blank or "nan" = empty
